Rent Potential & Upside

Multiple Income Strategies

Long-Term Rental

Apartments previously rented at $1,000 each; market rent runs $1,000–$1,200 per 1BR apartment, with the main house supporting $2,000–$2,400/mo if leased.

Rent-By-Room

6–8+ rooms across the main house and apartments support an estimated $3,500–$5,000+/mo, with kitchenette potential in the apartments and shared outdoor space on the large lot.

Short-Term Rental

Est. $120–$180/night at 55–70% occupancy ($3,000–$5,000+/mo projected). The large lot and golf course proximity are a plus; STR viability needs local confirmation.

Subsidized Program Fit

1BR Section 8 FMR in Indianapolis (FY2026) runs approximately $1,267. The property may also qualify for VASH, RRH, BRRH, or group-home / sober-living use, supported by the large lot and layout, plus proximity to hospitals, employers, and transit corridors.

Rehab Scope

Value-Add Opportunities

The main house has already been updated and needs virtually nothing. Both apartments need interior work, ranging from a rent-ready basic turn to a full flip-level finish. Buyer to verify all condition items independently.

  • Full cosmetic and finish work on both apartments — flooring, kitchens, baths, drywall, and paint
  • Main house is move-in ready as-is — no rehab budget allocated
  • Seller is already covering apartment rewiring prior to close
  • Add laundry — coin-op or in-unit
  • Utility bill-back setup across units
  • Possible additional bedroom or reconfiguration
  • Landscaping and curb appeal across the large lot
  • Garage monetization or storage income; RBR or STR conversion potential
